The store's get_ref returned commentary_ref NULL before the invoke and this ref after it, which is the control that attributes the put to this act. 1 invocation, 0 TypeError, 0 Traceback; duration 48772.93 ms, consistent with a real model call rather than a short-circuit. THE STEP-6 REASON THIS INSTANCE FIRST GAVE WAS WRONG AND IS REPLACED (AMENDMENT 6): step 6 answered CompositionRefused INVALID_REQUEST because of the request id's SHAPE, not because the request was absent. commentary_composition.py:71-84 (parse_request) refuses on the shape REQ-[0-9a-f]{24}, while an ABSENT request answers UNAVAILABLE at :117, and the admit's OPAQUE_ID_RE at _keys/keys.py:62 is wider -- so step 6's id passed the admit and failed the reader. This seat confirmed the issuer's diagnosis with its own control: REQ-4b5155ac2ea9467ab771b414 fullmatches REQ-[0-9a-f]{24} at 24 hex characters while step 6's REQ-0b2t1aaa does not, so the two ids differ in exactly the property the reader tests. STEP 5'S FOUR VERDICTS ARE INFERRED, IN THAT WORD (CTO msg 4220), and the reason is the instrument, not the evidence: iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy is unavailable to this account's agent principal, so no simulate verdict is claimed and the verdicts rest on reading the policy documents. So the gap is account-wide and not lane-specific. THE FOUR INFERRED VERDICTS, taken by subtraction from a printed denominator of 0 inline and exactly 3 attached policies holding 9 statements: (1) dynamodb:GetItem on irpt-requests DENIED -- no statement names any dynamodb action; (2) kms:Decrypt on IRPT's key 7f4d3042 DENIED -- no statement names any kms action, and the key's own policy is the default root delegation with 0 mentions of this role, which is where a simulator is blind; (3) lambda:InvokeFunction on the reader ALLOWED, resource-scoped to one ARN; (4) lambda:InvokeFunction on the store ALLOWED, resource-scoped to one ARN. The transcripts key is reached by GRANT, not policy: exactly one grant for this role, operations Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, DescribeKey. WHAT IS STILL OPEN AND WHY IT IS NOT THIS SEAT'S TO CLOSE: 6b.4's receive-and-delete of the one commentary_ready message is AccessDenied for this seat -- sqs:receivemessage is not in its identity policy and the queue policy grants receive and delete only to irpt-ycharts-runner-role.
